svg.title: Two-person timeline for Josef Pyrć and Zofia Gościńska
svg.desc: Vertical timeline with Joseph's lifeline on the left and Sophie's on the right. Shared events are horizontal lines joining both lifelines. Hollow markers are uncertain or disputed: Sophie's 1893 birth date on her death certificate, and Joseph's possible 1905 trip to the USA. Joseph: born Josef Pyrć 1879, possible trip 1905, arrived US 1911, died 1940 in an auto accident. Sophie: born Zofia Gościńska 1883, death certificate birth date 1893, arrived US 1912, citizen petition as Pyrch 1933, naturalized 1938, died 1964 of a heart condition. Shared: married in Muszyna 1910; births of Stanley 1911, Betty 1913, Charlie 1917, Ted 1920, Bobbie 1923; Pyrce name change 1938.
